ma.closeBLEConnection(Object object)

Disconnect from Bluetooth Low Energy device (minimum version: 24.6.0)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
deviceId String Yes Bluetooth device id
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String closeBLEConnection: ok

object.fail Callback Function

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String error message

Sample Code

ma.closeBLEConnection({
  deviceId: 'deviceId',
  success: (res) => {
    ma.showModal({
      title: 'closeBLEConnection success',
      content: JSON.stringify(res),
      showCancel: false
    })
  },
  fail: (res) => {
    ma.showModal({
      title: 'closeBLEConnection fail',
      content: JSON.stringify(res),
      showCancel: false
    })
  }
})
